title: PERFECT PEACE AT MIDNIGHT
ISAIAH 26:3-4 PRAYER
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: Your spinning thoughts refuse to rest tonight.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength.
Lord, anchor every anxious heart listening in the calm of this hour.
Steadfast God, guard our minds against fear and fill us with Your quiet assurance.
Amen. When spinning thoughts refuse to rest.

captions: Your spinning thoughts refuse to rest tonight.
As the midnight hour deepens, your mind wrestles with what lies ahead.
Turn your focus back to God, for His Word promises:
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength.
Lord, anchor every anxious heart listening in the calm of this hour.
We surrender every heavy outcome and rest upon Your everlasting strength tonight.
Steadfast God, guard our minds against fear and fill us with Your quiet assurance.
Amen. When spinning thoughts refuse to rest.
